title: Local demo: Add two integers
description:
Development sample. Return the sum of two integers. These are function arguments, not stdin.

| a | b | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 3 | 5 |
| -7 | 4 | -3 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 |

C++ example:

```cpp
int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
```

Rust example:

```rust
fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { a + b }
```
reference: int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
